title: Replace the fast-tier committee
body: Queues a new committee for 10 days, then anyone runs Gov.Apply (within 14 days). Needs a new DKG ceremony first: Committee is a JSON list of member wallets, Share-Public-Keys a JSON list in the same order, Group-Key the new group key, Threshold at least 2. Old members keep their earned fees. A Gov.Cancel proposal to the fast tier can stop it.
